# Pratik Palkar

> Project Manager for SEO, GEO and AI product, based in Mumbai, India, with 7+ years in organic growth. Leads SEO and generative engine optimization (GEO/AEO) delivery for 5+ clients and an SEO team at Growisto across BFSI (mutual funds, digital lending), D2C/e-commerce and B2B SaaS, with earlier agency experience across a large automotive client portfolio. Turns CRO findings into wireframes with Claude, and designed and shipped a 13-tool internal AI suite for SEO and GEO workflows. Open to digital product, growth and senior SEO/GEO roles, especially in BFSI and banking.

## Specialisms

Technical SEO, generative engine optimization (GEO), answer engine optimization (AEO), schema and entity optimization, AI Overview and LLM citation tracking, llms.txt and AI-crawler access configuration, content architecture for LLM retrieval, internal linking, link building and citation outreach, CRO for organic landing pages (findings turned into wireframes and layout mockups with Claude), developer-ready technical specs without writing production code, ASO, automotive SEO. Sector experience: BFSI (mutual funds, digital lending), D2C and e-commerce, B2B SaaS, automotive.

## Results

Client names withheld under NDA. Figures from Google Search Console and GA4.

- **Mutual fund (BFSI), India:** organic traffic up 2x in just 3 months.
- **D2C sports equipment brand, India:** non-brand organic clicks up 3.1x over 10 months, 8,098 to 25,358 per month, on a 39% impression rise, so non-brand CTR more than doubled from 0.42% to 0.94%; LLM-sourced sessions up 3.7x over 8 months, 686 to 2,531 per month.
- **Consumer energy brand, India:** non-brand organic clicks up 3.7x over 14 months, 4,600 to 17,100 per month, with 7,087 to 17,100 in the final three months; AI-sourced traffic up 12.6x, 87 to 1,100 monthly sessions.
- **Kids edutainment site, US:** a new site launched into the US market reached 4,065 monthly non-brand clicks and 251,623 non-brand impressions in four months, against entrenched category leaders; total organic clicks up 3.2x from 1,979 to 6,426 with brand traffic flat, so non-brand went from nothing to 63% of all organic clicks.

Across the D2C, energy and edutainment accounts, in different sectors and markets, non-brand organic clicks roughly tripled. Every one of those three accounts hit its agreed targets across the period.

**Beyond traffic (lending client, India, at Ethinos Digital):** the client was getting many loan applications but almost all were being rejected. The cause was the previous agency's content, which targeted low-CIBIL-score loan queries and drew applicants who could never qualify. Removing that content solved the problem and the client was happy with the outcome.

## Built

The Growisto AI Suite: 13 internal SEO/GEO tools (5 live web apps, 8 plugins), scoped and built with Claude, using the Claude/OpenAI APIs, Bright Data API and Ahrefs API, version-controlled on GitHub and deployed on Render.com. Tools include an AI Overview Citation Scraper, a 106-parameter SEO Technical Audit, Competitor Analyzer, Seasonality Dashboard, Schema Audit, SEO Page Level Audit, Keyword Classifier, Backlink Shortlister, Internal Linking analyser, SEO Meta Tag Generator, Blog Content Review, Content Creator and SEO Potential Analysis.
